description: Recurring residential or commercial utility statement (electric, gas, water, or municipal service) corroborating physical service address and account holder residency. Where to read: Identified by utility provider masthead, meter/usage summary, "Service Address" block, and billing statement date within the recency window. Distinguish from: Do NOT confuse with a government-issued photo identity document (`gov-id`), and carefully separate the physical `service_address` from a P.O. Box or billing/mailing address.

name.description: Full name of the utility account holder as printed on the statement. Where to read: Account Summary or Customer Address block at the top of Page 1. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the utility provider's corporate name or remit-to payee.

service_address.description: Physical street address where utility service is metered and delivered. Where to read: Explicit 'Service Address' or 'Service Location' field above the meter reading table. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the 'Mailing Address', 'Billing Address', or utility remittance P.O. Box.

statement_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the billing statement was issued. Where to read: Top-right Statement Summary box ('Statement Date' or 'Bill Date'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the 'Payment Due Date' or historical 'Previous Bill Date'.
